test_objective: Check that you can query the temporal evolution of entities matching the given NGSI-LD query

test_cases.name: 021_08_01 Query the temporal evolution of entities matching the given NGSI-LD query
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query the temporal evolution of entities matching the given NGSI-LD query
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Request response body containing a list that contains Entity Temporal Elements
    compared with file 'vehicles-temporal-representation-021-08-expectation.jsonld'
    and using the list of entity ids define in '${temporal_entities_representation_ids}' and
        Response Status Code set to 200
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: ngsild_query set to 'speed>90' and
    Query Parameter: timerel set to 'after' and
    Query Parameter: timeAt set to '2020-07-01T12:05:00Z' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
